priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore polling interval cancellation
findings.body: The interval handle is discarded and the returned disposer does nothing. Polling therefore continues after cleanup, repeatedly invoking refresh, retaining resources, and potentially preventing a Node.js process from exiting.

findings.title: [P2] Restore removal of the socket message handler
findings.body: The returned disposer no longer detaches `handler`. With a long-lived socket or repeated attach/cleanup cycles, stale handlers and their captured state remain retained, every message invokes all accumulated handlers, and EventEmitter listener limits may be exceeded.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer after registering handler with socket.on at line 2. The base-to-head diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup continues to retain and invoke the handler after detachment.
